domain: Cognitive Telemetry, Aphantasia/Hyperphantasia Imagery Spectrum, Drift-Diffusion RT Variability & Working Memory Chunking
title: Psychophysical Telemetry, Mental Imagery Extremes & Drift-Diffusion Gating Corpus
description: Full-text empirical and theoretical papers grounding Aura's 3 micro-game cognitive telemetry probes (Pulse Reaction / Drift-Diffusion RT IIV, Constellation Working-Memory Chunking, and Mind's Eye Imagery Spectrum) and the Aphantasia Openness De-Confounder rule.

papers.title: A cognitive profile of multi-sensory imagery, memory and dreaming in aphantasia

aura_parameter_mapping.mechanistic_link: Demonstrates across N=267 congenital aphantasic and N=400 control participants that near-total absence of voluntary visual imagery (V1 sensory rendering) leaves spatial working memory, abstract schematic representation, and conceptual reasoning completely intact. Because standard Big Five Openness inventories heavily weight visual-aesthetic imagery items ('vivid imagination', 'pictures in my mind'), concept-first aphantasic thinkers are systematically underestimated by 12%–18% in Openness/Imagination despite rich non-visual conceptual modeling.

papers.title: Task evoked EEG reveals neural processing differences in aphantasia

aura_parameter_mapping.mechanistic_link: Shows via task-evoked event-related potentials (ERPs) during mental rotation and imagery paradigms that aphantasic individuals achieve equivalent behavioral accuracy to high-imagery controls through distinct neural signatures (non-retinotopic conceptual, spatial, and propositional strategies). Grounds Aura's zero-jargon validation of `wordless_concept` ('Concept-First Mind') and `inner_voice` ('Deep Inner-Voice Mind') as alternative cortical encoding architectures rather than deficits.

Models the continuous vividness spectrum from congenital Aphantasia ('imagery agnosia' / pure semantic knowing without sensory projection, <=18) through Soft Sketch Imagery (19..45) and Vivid Mental Imagery (46..80) to Hyperphantasia (>=81, cinema-grade top-down sensory synthesis). Explains how high abstract systemizing (Intellect) flourishes when top-down feedback decouples from V1 visual rendering.

papers.title: BOLD correlates of trial-by-trial reaction time variability in gray and white matter: a multi-study fMRI analysis

aura_parameter_mapping.mechanistic_link: Establishes across 5 independent fMRI datasets that intra-individual reaction time variability (RT IIV, quantified via coefficient of variation rt_cv_pct) tracks trial-by-trial fluctuations in dorsolateral prefrontal / anterior cingulate attentional control and default-mode network suppression. In Aura's `pulse_reaction` telemetry probe, `rt_cv_pct > 22%` provides an objective behavioral signature of phasic, spark-driven attentional gating (`adhd_dopamine_forager` / `audhd_dual_attractor`).

papers.title: Cognitive Effort in the Two-Step Task: An Active Inference Drift-Diffusion Model Approach
key_equations: dx(t) = v(\gamma, \Delta G)\,dt + s\,dW(t), \qquad \text{RT} = t_0 + \inf\{t : |x(t)| \ge a\}

aura_parameter_mapping.mechanistic_link: Unifies Active Inference policy precision (gamma, striatal dopamine tone) with Drift-Diffusion Model (DDM) reaction-time dynamics. Shows that trial-by-trial drift rate v and boundary separation a are modulated by expected free energy differences and cognitive effort allocation, explaining why spark-driven nervous systems exhibit variable RT cadence (`rt_cv_pct > 22%`) and anticipatory `false_starts` during simple unstimulating waiting intervals.

papers.title: Synaptic Theory of Chunking in Working Memory

aura_parameter_mapping.mechanistic_link: Formulates a short-term synaptic plasticity model of hierarchical chunking in working memory, proving that compressing multi-item spatial constellations into unified relational schemas bypasses raw slot bottlenecks and accelerates within-chunk retrieval transitions (`mean_chunk_ms`). Directly grounds Aura's `constellation_memory` probe, where high `accuracy_pct` paired with fast `mean_chunk_ms` boosts abstract pattern synthesis (`O_intellect` and systemizing priors).
